name: Tripuram Shantam
meaning: A prayer to the Goddess of the three worlds, the source of all power, who removes every hardship.
note: The client list’s transcription could not be matched to a published text; it is held back until it is checked.
supplied:
Tripuram Tripuram Shantam,
Tripureswaram Mahakritam,
Maha Devyam Sarva Shakthim,
Sarva Dharmadharinim. Sarva Jeevanam Tam Hleem,
Sarva Kasta Nivarinim Swaha
